skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 90% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 190% ATK DMG to a single back-row target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Weak] on the target (reduces ATK% for 2 turns).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 190% ATK DMG to a single back-row target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Weak] on the target (reduces ATK by 30% for 2 turns).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self max HP%. When deployed together with Frog Man, increases self ATK%.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self max HP by 30%. When deployed together with Frog Man, increases self ATK by 30%.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self max HP by 35%. When deployed together with Frog Man, increases self ATK by 35%.

effects.desc: Unfavorable effect reduces the target's damage reduction rate by 30% for the duration.
